audit_findings.detail: The revised Task independently scopes active-user, event and page reports and retains the combined snapshot. The original ga4-live-sources obligation is renamed ga4-realtime-sources with its source/medium grouping and active-user measure preserved. The three original review source spans establish the added standalone invocation scopes.

The revised Task expressly preserves the full metadata response, including the same full value in saved data. It separates dimension-only, metric-only and high-level available-fields requests. This avoids shrinking the full-response contract to a named subset of entry fields. Source: api-reference.md:185-193 and metadata.ts:82-95.

The revised Task states that an empty path list returns zero rows without a GA4 request, while separately preserving the conflict between default-enabled saving and the early return before saveResult. The explicit missing semantic choice is whether this early return is an intended exception to the documented save duty. It does not silently deem saving unnecessary or claim that the source has been fixed.

The revised Task still requires supplied filters, sort order and row limit. Filters/orderBy remain explicitly unfulfilled by the actual request builder. A resolved Task conflict chooses the documented obligation; it does not repair the Skill. The Task still makes no claim about SDK semantics for zero, which the truthy request spread omits.

The revision has 15 added and three removed requirement IDs. configure-google-access is split into setup-google-access, setup-environment and configured-request-targets. ga4-field-metadata is replaced by four more precise metadata obligations. ga4-live-sources is renamed. Other added duties split existing pagination, per-URL outcomes and grouped-saving statements, alongside the review-requested empty-bulk case.
